an5.162:1.1: tatra kho āyasmā sārīputto bhikkhū āmantesi
an5.162:1.3: āvusoti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato sāriputtassa paccassosuṃ.
an5.162:2.1: pañcime āvuso āghātapaṭivinayā yattha bhikkhuno uppanno āghāto sabbaso paṭivinetabbo
an5.162:2.3: idhāvuso ekacco puggalo aparisuddhakāyasamācāro hoti parisuddhavacīsamācāro
an5.162:2.5: idha panāvuso ekacco puggalo aparisuddhavacīsamācāro hoti parisuddhakāyasamācāro
an5.162:2.7: idha panāvuso ekacco puggalo aparisuddhakāyasamācāro hoti aparisuddhavacīsamācāro labhati ca kālena kālaṃ cetaso vivaraṃ cetaso pasādaṃ
an5.162:2.9: idha panāvuso ekacco puggalo aparisuddhakāyasamācāro hoti aparisuddhavacīsamācāro na ca labhati kālena kālaṃ cetaso vivaraṃ cetaso pāsādaṃ
an5.162:2.11: idha panāvuso ekacco puggalo parisuddhakāyasamācāro hoti parisuddhavacīsamācāro labhati ca kālena kālaṃ cetaso vivaraṃ cetaso pasādaṃ
an5.162:3.1: tatrāvuso yvāyaṃ puggalo aparisuddhakāyasamācāro parisuddhavacīsamācāro kathaṃ tasmiṃ puggale āghāto paṭivinetabbo
an5.162:3.2: seyyathāpi āvuso bhikkhu paṃsukūliko rathiyāya nantakaṃ disvā vāmena pādena niggahetvā dakkhiṇena pādena pattharitvā yo tattha sāro taṃ paripātetvā ādāya pakkameyya
an5.162:3.3: evameva kho āvuso yvāyaṃ puggalo aparisuddhakāyasamācāro parisuddhavacīsamācāro yāssa aparisuddhakāyasamācāratā na sāssa tasmiṃ samaye manasikātabbā yā ca khvassa parisuddhavacīsamācāratā sāssa tasmiṃ samaye manasikātabbā
an5.162:4.1: tatrāvuso yvāyaṃ puggalo aparisuddhavacīsamācāro parisuddhakāyasamācāro kathaṃ tasmiṃ puggale āghāto paṭivinetabbo
an5.162:4.3: atha puriso āgaccheyya ghammābhitatto ghammapareto kilanto tasito pipāsito
an5.162:4.4: so taṃ pokkharaṇiṃ ogāhetvā ubhohi hatthehi sevālapaṇakaṃ apaviyūhitvā añjalinā pivitvā pakkameyya
an5.162:4.5: evameva kho āvuso yvāyaṃ puggalo aparisuddhavacīsamācāro parisuddhakāyasamācāro yāssa aparisuddhavacīsamācāratā na sāssa tasmiṃ samaye manasikātabbā yā ca khvassa parisuddhakāyasamācāratā sāssa tasmiṃ samaye manasikātabbā
an5.162:5.1: tatrāvuso yvāyaṃ puggalo aparisuddhakāyasamācāro aparisuddhavacīsamācāro labhati ca kālena kālaṃ cetaso vivaraṃ cetaso pasādaṃ kathaṃ tasmiṃ puggale āghāto paṭivinetabbo
an5.162:5.3: atha puriso āgaccheyya ghammābhitatto ghammapareto kilanto tasito pipāsito
an5.162:5.6: sacāhaṃ añjalinā vā pivissāmi bhājanena vā khobhissāmipi taṃ loḷissāmipi taṃ apeyyampi taṃ karissāmi
an5.162:5.7: yannūnāhaṃ catukuṇṭhiko nipatitvā gopītakaṃ pivitvā pakkameyyanti
an5.162:5.8: so catukuṇṭhiko nipatitvā gopītakaṃ pivitvā pakkameyya
an5.162:5.9: evameva kho āvuso yvāyaṃ puggalo aparisuddhakāyasamācāro aparisuddhavacīsamācāro labhati ca kālena kālaṃ cetaso vivaraṃ cetaso pasādaṃ yāssa aparisuddhakāyasamācāratā na sāssa tasmiṃ samaye manasikātabbā
an5.162:5.10: yāpissa aparisuddhavacīsamācāratā na sāpissa tasmiṃ samaye manasikātabbā
an5.162:5.11: yañca kho so labhati kālena kālaṃ cetaso vivaraṃ cetaso pasādaṃ tadevassa tasmiṃ samaye manasikātabbaṃ
an5.162:6.1: tatrāvuso yvāyaṃ puggalo aparisuddhakāyasamācāro aparisuddhavacīsamācāro na labhati kālena kālaṃ cetaso vivaraṃ cetaso pasādaṃ kathaṃ tasmiṃ puggale āghāto paṭivinetabbo
an5.162:6.2: seyyathāpī āvuso puriso ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno addhānamaggapaṭipanno
an5.162:6.3: tassa puratopīssa dūre gāmo pacchatopissa dūre gāmo
an5.162:6.4: so na labheyya sappāyāni bhojanāni na labheyya sappāyāni bhesajjāni na labheyya paṭirūpaṃ upaṭṭhākaṃ na labheyya gāmantanāyakaṃ
an5.162:6.6: so tasmiṃ purise kāruññaṃyeva upaṭṭhāpeyya anudayaṃyeva upaṭṭhāpeyya anukampaṃyeva upaṭṭhāpeyya
an5.162:6.7: aho vatāyaṃ puriso labheyya sappāyāni bhojanāni labheyya sappāyāni bhesajjāni labheyya paṭirūpaṃ upaṭṭhākaṃ labheyya gāmantanāyakaṃ
an5.162:6.10: evameva kho āvuso yvāyaṃ puggalo aparisuddhakāyasamācāro aparisuddhavacīsamācāro na ca labhati kālena kālaṃ cetaso vivaraṃ cetaso pasādaṃ evarūpepi āvuso puggale kāruññaṃyeva upaṭṭhāpetabbaṃ anudayāyeva upaṭṭhāpetabbā anukampāyeva upaṭṭhāpetabbā
an5.162:6.11: aho vata ayamāyasmā kāyaduccaritaṃ pahāya kāyasucaritaṃ bhāveyya vacīduccaritaṃ pahāya vacīsucaritaṃ bhāveyya manoduccaritaṃ pahāya manosucaritaṃ bhāveyya
an5.162:6.13: māyamāyasmā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjīti
an5.162:7.1: tatrāvuso yvāyaṃ puggalo parisuddhakāyasamācāro parisuddhavacīsamācāro labhati ca kālena kālaṃ cetaso vivaraṃ cetaso pasādaṃ kathaṃ tasmiṃ puggale āghāto paṭivinetabbo
an5.162:7.2: seyyathāpi āvuso pokkharaṇī acchodakā sātodakā sītodakā setodakā supatiṭṭhā rammaṇīyā nānārukkhehi sañchannā
an5.162:7.3: atha puriso āgaccheyya ghammābhitatto ghammapareto kilanto tasito pipāsito
an5.162:7.4: so taṃ pokkharaṇiṃ ogāhetvā nhātvā ca pivitvā ca paccuttaritvā tattheva rukkhachāyāya nisīdeyya vā nipajjeyya vā
an5.162:8.1: evameva kho āvuso yvāyaṃ puggalo parisuddhakāyasamācāro parisuddhavacīsamācāro labhati ca kālena kālaṃ cetaso vivaraṃ cetaso pasādaṃ yāpissa parisuddhakāyasamācāratā sāpissa tasmiṃ samaye manasikātabbā
an5.162:8.2: yāpissa parisuddhavacīsamācāratā sāpissa tasmiṃ samaye manasikātabbā
an5.162:8.3: yampi so labhati kālena kālaṃ cetaso vivaraṃ cetaso pasādaṃ tampissa tasmiṃ samaye manasikātabbaṃ
an5.162:8.5: samantapāsādikaṃ āvuso puggalaṃ āgamma cittaṃ pasīdati.
an5.162:9.1: ime kho āvuso pañca āghātapaṭivinayā yattha bhikkhuno uppanno āghāto sabbaso paṭivinetabboti.
